example_assumptions.losses: U1 0.6 W, U41 0.5 W, U61 0.25 W are hypothetical; no measured device losses.
example_assumptions.materials: 0.3 W/mK dielectric, 385 W/mK copper and 0.025 mm via plating are illustrative values, not coupon measurements.
example_assumptions.cooling: Top and bottom convection are prescribed at 10 W/m2K; airflow is not solved.
example_assumptions.package_paths: Junction-case and case-board resistances are assumed; package geometry is not resolved.
example_assumptions.scope: Layered board finite-volume model: one depth cell per imported stackup row; rectangular board bounds. Zones are excluded because this board import lacks trustworthy source-filled zone copper. Not a full 3D package/airflow solve.

issues.message: Copper union sampled at 6 x 6 points per cell; area and edges are approximate.
Structured layered board only: no tetrahedra, package volume, board cutouts, radiation, or calibrated package heat spreading.
